name: Kejourou
source:
A long-haired monster who left Yamatai Village for the mountains alongside Shirohebi. A malicious, stubborn monster, she enjoys toying with men using her sexual hair skills. Though she does dislike killing, so she doesn't play with them until they die. After finishing with the man, she usually leaves them abandoned on the roadside.

She sometimes disguises herself as a prostitute to seduce men. In the middle of intercourse, she finds great humor in revealing her true monster character.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
